Introduction

IDID is a seven-member boy group under Starship Entertainment. Formed through the reality show Debut's Plan, they made their debut in September 15, 2025. Park Junhwan officially left the group on June 2, 2025.

The survival show Debut's Plan first aired on the YouTube channel "NewKids On the Starship" (now IDID) on March 14, 2025. The finale premiered live on May 4, 2025. The group was chosen by taking 5 members based on board evaluation and total votes: Kim Minjae, Jang Yonghoon, Baek Junhyuk, Park Wonbin, and Chu Yoochan. Jeong Semin was chosen through fan votes, with former member Park Junhwan being a producer's pick, and Park Seonghyeon added as an additional member.

The name "IDID" is an abbreviation for "I did it!" which expresses their joy of being able to reach their dreams of debuting.
